other_conditions: The applicant must be an active weaver member of a primary weaver cooperative society
The applicant must be affiliated with the Chhattisgarh State Handloom Union, Raipur
Only one weaver from each district who has produced the maximum cloth in that district is eligible
The weaver must not be a defaulter with the cooperative society
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹11,000 is provided to eligible senior weavers.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
